The '''Sanjin Green Hawks''' captured [[Laakteen Depot]] on behalf of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ace [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Kufra Ahara]] performed modifications that helped them take the outpost. <ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
